tips.alert.aquatic_o2: 💡 Tip: Aquatic plants have low O₂ — tap 'Aerate' to restore dissolved oxygen
tips.alert.hungry: 💡 Tip: Your pets are hungry! Refill the food bowl and they'll line up to eat
tips.alert.land_dry: 💡 Tip: Some plants are wilting from dry air — tap 'Mist' soon to prevent withering
tips.alert.sand_wet: 💡 Tip: Desert humidity ≥80% overwaters succulents & aloe — pause misting or turn on Heat Lamp (☀️) to speed up evaporation
tips.biome.aquatic: 💡 Aquatic Tip: Bubble Rock slows O₂ loss; Betta fish need a solo tank while Shrimp & Guppies school peacefully
tips.biome.meadow: 💡 Meadow Tip: Mossy Boulder + Shallow Pool with high humidity attracts fireflies, moths & tree frogs
tips.biome.rainforest: 💡 Rainforest Tip: Mini Waterfall slows evaporation — warm mist unlocks Orchids, Pitcher Plants & Chameleons
tips.biome.sand: 💡 Desert Tip: Pair Sandstone, Driftwood & a Heat Lamp for warm dry air to unlock Lithops, Scorpions & Geckos
tips.click_next_help: Click to show next eco tip
tips.general.1: 💡 Tip: Desert flora thrive in dry air (25%~55%) and become overwatered at ≥80% humidity
tips.general.10: 💡 Tip: Tap any plant or placed decor on the stage to transplant or move it to a free green tile
tips.general.11: 💡 Tip: Click the temperature readout (e.g. 22°C) on the sensor card to toggle between °C and °F
tips.general.12: 💡 Tip: Tap the 📸 button on the tank bar to export a crisp 4x pixel Polaroid snapshot
tips.general.2: 💡 Tip: Your very first Mist (or Aerate in fish tanks) in a new tank always sprouts a starter plant
tips.general.3: 💡 Tip: Petting critters unlocks niche perching at Lv.2 and hunger/eco perks at Lv.3 & Lv.5
tips.general.4: 💡 Tip: Rapidly clicking a pet startles it for 60s; reaching Lv.4 Trust makes them fearless
tips.general.5: 💡 Tip: Predators & bugs auto-swap safely into your roster — no pet is ever eaten
tips.general.6: 💡 Tip: Heat Lamps (☀️) & Cooling Fans (❄️) help unlock rare flora and critters like Orchids & Chameleons
tips.general.7: 💡 Tip: Running 2+ healthy tanks of different biomes activates ✨Synergy (+10% flora spawn, +5% eff.)
tips.general.8: 💡 Tip: Pruning mature plants refunds +1 eco pt; removing newly sprouted seedlings refunds 0
tips.general.9: 💡 Tip: Offline progress settles up to 8 hours; stowed pets in your roster never consume food
